candidate_tasks_evaluated.description: All-puncture (0 <= p <= 119) E8 star label-decoder ratio exclusion, exact p=56 two-orbit dimension-loss classification, and sharp k-reader subspace support-union hierarchy U_1..U_9 = (56,84,100,108,112,116,118,119,120), extending PR #631, PR #875, and PR #939.
Coded coordinate-star factorizations for the five-port quadratic decoder at p=6 (v=192), extending PR #958 and PR #1046.
First cost-six puncture threshold for orthogonal E8 root pairs in the B14 model, complementing PR #1020.

investigated_object: Real E8 root-only star label-decoder cost C_star(P)/(120-p) across all puncture sizes 0 <= p <= 119 and the 255 weight-56 dimension-loss puncture sets at p=56
method: Live-quotient matroid rank reduction on C/K_P, W(E8) two-orbit classification of the 255 weight-56 codewords, 5-orbit k=3 subspace union census, k=4 hyperplane-incidence inequality, k=5..9 annihilator affine-hyperplane bound, and exact optimization over all 24,310 sorted 9-rank profiles across 0 <= p <= 119
deliverable: research/e8-star-all-punctures-seed49/ with verify.py, independent_check.py, test_package.py, CERTIFICATE.json, PROOF.md, README.md, SOURCES.json, OVERLAP.json, NOTICE.md, and VALIDATION.md
result_summary: Proved C_star^live(P)/(120-p) = C_star(P)/(120-p) >= 63/111 for all 0 <= p <= 119 (equality only at p=9), classified the 255 p=56 dimension-loss puncture sets into two W(E8) orbits of exact star costs 57/64 (size 135) and 50/64 (size 120), and certified the sharp subspace support-union hierarchy U_1..U_9 = (56,84,100,108,112,116,118,119,120). No new kappa claimed.
